<select>SELECT s.code,w.label,s.quantity FROM stock s INNER JOIN warehouse w ON w.code=s.warehouse
<where><if test="!includeInactive">s.active=0</if>
<if test="warehouseLabel != null and warehouseLabel != ''">AND w.label LIKE concat('%',#{warehouseLabel},'%')</if>
<if test="codes != null">AND s.code IN <foreach collection="codes" item="code" open="(" close=")" separator=",">#{code}</foreach></if></where></select>

parameterizedSql: SELECT s.code,s.quantity FROM stock s INNER JOIN warehouse w ON w.code=s.warehouse WHERE s.active=0 AND w.code=?
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock WHERE active=0

template: <select>SELECT warehouse,SUM(quantity) AS total FROM stock WHERE active=0 GROUP BY warehouse HAVING SUM(quantity) > #{minimum} ORDER BY warehouse</select>
<select>SELECT code,quantity FROM stock WHERE active=0 ORDER BY code LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{start}</select>
